content:
Change the name, greeting, and/or notes of the integration with integration key
integration_key , or reset its secret key. When modifying an Admin API integration
permissions can also be added or removed. Requires "Grant applications" API
permission.
Note: This API call uses POST data, which must be represented as JSON and cannot be
passed in via URL parameters. Some Duo clients (Python or Java, for example) offer
helper functions to handle requests to the Admin API.
